        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.nextLine();
        StringBuilder res = new StringBuilder();
        int ans = -1;
        res.append(s.charAt(0));
        int i = 1;
        while (i < s.length()) {
            if (i + 1 < s.length() && s.charAt(i) == 'a' && s.charAt(i + 1) == 't' && ans == -1) {
                ans = 1;
                res.append('@');
                i += 2;
            } else if (i + 2 < s.length() && s.charAt(i) == 'd' && s.charAt(i + 1) == 'o' && s.charAt(i + 2) == 't' && (i + 2) != s.length() - 1) {
                res.append('.');
                i += 3;
            } else {
                res.append(s.charAt(i));
                i++;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(res.toString());
        scanner.close();
    }
}
